name: connections-mcp

tools.name: connections_search_catalog
tools.description: Find something to run: your LOCAL tools on this machine (browser/shell/git/deploy/ssh/architect/…) and every API endpoint this workspace's company can call (first-party + connected third-party). A local tool's exact name → that one tool, catalog not searched. An endpoint's or Script Vault instrument's exact tool_name → that row first, ahead of every fuzzy hit (an instrument with its full description). Auto browser sign-in if needed (no key to paste).

query.description: What to find; blank → your full local-tool inventory.

use_case.description: What you are trying to get done, in a sentence (e.g. 'deploy the pay lambda and check its logs'). Sharpens the local-tool ranking; alone it is the query. The top local hit lists the tools usually run next here, and any hit its known pitfalls.

limit.description: Your CONTEXT budget - bounds the whole response, not just the endpoint list (default 8, max 25).

verbose.description: false (default): endpoint hits list param names only, local tools and Script Vault instruments a one-line summary. true: each hit's full parameter schema and description.

tools.name: connections_execute
tools.description: Run something found with connections_search_catalog. (1) A LOCAL tool on this machine: { local:true, tool_name, params }; runs here, no sign-in. (2) A catalog API ENDPOINT: { endpoint_id } (or service+tool_name); runs as this workspace's company with the vaulted credential injected server-side (value-blind; auto browser sign-in if needed, no key to paste). Target a connected account with `instance`.

local.description: true → run tool_name as a LOCAL tool instead of a catalog endpoint.

params_file.description: A JSON object file (relative to this workspace or absolute) read into params on this machine. Give params OR params_file, never both.

project.description: Which COMPANY/workspace THIS call runs against: a company id, project id or ref (Studio's ?project= on a catalog call; a one-call pin on a local tool, refused if you are not a member, and the reply names the workspace used). Not a params field. Omit for this chat's workspace.

company.description: Run this call as another company you belong to (companyId, projectId or exact name from connections_list_companies), e.g. email_action inbox.threads for its inbox. Refused if you are not a member. Omit for this workspace's own company.

files.description: Catalog endpoints only: { "<params field>": "<file path>" }; this machine reads each file into that params field as base64 (dotted, e.g. "data_base64"), so the bytes never pass through you. Never base64 a file yourself.

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath applied to the JSON answer, e.g. body.items[*].id (grammar: connections_briefing).
